functions.name: GET
functions.description: One PowerPath value: npv, irr, dscr, breach_months, exposure, source, confidence, value, rank, deliverable_mw or time_to_target.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: npv, irr, dscr, breach_months, exposure, source, confidence, value, rank, deliverable_mw, time_to_target

parameters.name: arg1
parameters.description: Input key (exposure, source, confidence, value, rank) or case: upside, base, downside (deliverability)

parameters.name: arg2
parameters.description: Configuration name (deliverability fields; blank for the first)

functions.name: TABLE
functions.description: A spilled PowerPath table: priorities, pathbridge, deliverability, market, history, plants, plant_cf or fields.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: priorities, pathbridge, deliverability, market, history, plants, plant_cf or fields

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Path name (pathbridge), days (market), metric (history), fuel (plants) or plant id (plant_cf)

functions.name: BRIDGE
functions.description: What-if on the approved case. Splits the change in NPV, IRR and DSCR by cause; parts add up to the total.

parameters.name: drivers
parameters.description: Two-column range: input key, new value

functions.name: MARKET
functions.description: Trailing power-market average for the project: lmp_da, spark_spread, henry_hub, retail_industrial, retail_commercial, ba_demand or fuel_mix.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: lmp_da, spark_spread, henry_hub, retail_industrial, retail_commercial, ba_demand, fuel_mix

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: e.g. avg, on_peak, off_peak, stdev, value, avg_mw, gas, renewables, carbon_t_per_mwh

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Override the project market profile (NYISO zone, state, BA code)

functions.name: PLANT
functions.description: Power plant facts and capacity factor from EIA: cf_12m, cf_avg, cf_worst, worst_year, cf_year, summer_mw and more.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: PowerPath project id (its market profile sets the state)

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: name, fuel, ba, nameplate_mw, summer_mw, cf_12m, cf_avg, cf_worst, worst_year, cf_year, worst_month_cf, worst_month_avg_mw, latest_month
